agent_explanation: Oblique high-speed circle-circle impact injects energy: at step 10 bodies approach with speeds ~9.8 and ~56.6 and conserved energy ~3451J, but by step 11 after the glancing contact (gap 0.03) speeds are ~66.9 and ~53.3 with energy ~29442J. Inelastic (e=0) variant still violates, so it is not restitution gain; missing the collision removes it. Likely cause is incorrect impulse resolution for oblique contacts with large mass ratio at high relative velocity within substeps (e.g. normal miscomputed or positional correction adding velocity, repeated impulses per substep).
